title: Immersive Virtual Reality Arcade Experience for 1 Hour (Includes Training)
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Players under 18 require waiver signed by guardian. Minimum age of 8 years old.
Most glasses fit the VR headset, with maximum frame size of 6 inches wide and 2 inches tall. If your glasses are too large, please bring contacts.
Players who have major conditions such as epilepsy or heart conditions should not play.

There is no minimum height, but users at least four (4) feet or taller will have a better VR experience. On the flip side, any guest who is seven (7) feet or taller may also experience a less-optimal VR experience.
policies: IMPORTANT: You MUST arrive 5 minutes or earlier prior to the start time for training.
In multiplayer games, you can see and hear your friends in the same virtual world.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Levelup Reality is Toronto’s highest rated virtual reality (VR) arcade and events venue. We have been ranked as TripAdvisor's Top 3 Fun and Games / Things to Do (TripAdvisor Traveler's Choice).

We are one of the coolest indoor activities and most definitely an adventurous thing to do in Downtown Toronto GTA!

We host unforgettable corporate events, business team building games, birthday parties, holiday parties, large group game parties for individuals, companies and offices in Toronto.

Enjoy single and multiplayer content including adventure, action, horror, escape room, shooter/fps, and short film experiences! We have one of the largest libraries of games!
